CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 0

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

5. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 12

7. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 14

8. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

9. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. A — 64
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 8
3. Product = 64
Final Answer: 64
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

4. D — 144
Working:

2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12

6. A — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100
5. c = 10
Final Answer: 10 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

7. B — 9
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 14 − 5
3. x = 9
Final Answer: x = 9
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

Final Answer: 12
